top.line: A reply to Markus Franz: who hands out the work? A person sets it, one conductor hands it out, a person signs off.
top.para: And a door that can close.

in-short.line: A desk not an agent; his question; both; person and conductor; specialists and reviewer; one door that closes.

door.line: Start with one conductor and only talk to that one; the direct route stays open.
